title: This Bird Builds an Optical Illusion to Win Over a Mate
subject: great bowerbird

scenes.text: A bird that learned a trick film directors use, and it works on mates.
The male great bowerbird builds a stick tunnel and decorates the court in front of it.
He places small stones near the tunnel and bigger ones farther out.
From inside the tunnel, where the female looks, everything seems the same size, and the court looks smaller.
Researchers who rearranged the stones found he fixed them within three days.
The males with the best illusion won the mates. A bird that fakes perspective.

description:
A bird that learned a film director's trick.
The male great bowerbird sorts stones by size to create a forced-perspective illusion, and the best illusionists win mates.
Could you spot the illusion? Comment below.
